commit.subject: lampOS: collect early Skills helper refusals

preservation.file_predicate: Identical skills.join("desk-tutor").join("skill.toml").is_file() is evaluated once into preserved before the assertions; assert!(preserved) retains the predicate.

plan.transport_boundary: Baseline and candidate use byte-identical child-exit polling, with20-second watchdog and10ms polling; baseline retains old unconditional write unwrap. Candidate additionally asserts observed BrokenPipe after all original product predicates. No fixed completion delay.
plan.reader_scope: Private integration helper and documentation only. Full Skills target census plus strict Skills all-targets/workspace build; root approved no12-package runtime expansion.
plan.executions: Exactly once per control, one focused package selection, one full Skills default-parallel gate; no retries.

production_source_scope: No product code or manifest changed in the candidate or either control. The controls only alter the integration fixture and candidate documentation snapshot.
publication_scope: No Python, executable, whole-source export, Cargo compiler-message JSON, or API actor metadata is bundled.
